meta.description: Theoretical endgames - must-know positions with precise results

positions.name: Rule of the Square
positions.keyConcept: Pawn promotes if enemy king outside square

positions.name: Direct & Distant Opposition
positions.keyConcept: Opposition = kings on same file/rank/diagonal with one square between

positions.name: Triangulation
positions.keyConcept: Maneuver to give opponent move in same position

positions.name: Outside Passed Pawn
positions.keyConcept: Passed pawn on flank wins by diverting king
positions.studyMethod: Calculate king distraction, promote other pawn

positions.name: Protected Passed Pawn
positions.keyConcept: Protected passer = permanent asset, king tied down

positions.name: Breakthrough Patterns
positions.keyConcept: Sacrifice pawns to create passed pawn

positions.name: Reti Maneuver (King hunts two pawns)
positions.keyConcept: King moves diagonally to threaten both pawns

categories.name: Rook Endgames
categories.description: Most common endgame (50%+ of all endgames), activity > material

positions.name: Lucena Position (Winning)
positions.keyConcept: Build bridge with rook, advance pawn, mate threat
positions.studyMethod: Memorize bridge building: Rf4, Kf7, Rf8, Ke7, etc.

positions.name: Philidor Position (Drawing)
positions.keyConcept: Rook on 3rd/6th rank, cut off king, check from behind
positions.studyMethod: Practice: rook on 6th, king behind pawn, check from behind

positions.name: Vancura Position (Drawing)
positions.keyConcept: Rook behind pawn, checks from side, king shelter
positions.studyMethod: Learn rook behind passed pawn defense

positions.name: Rook Behind Passed Pawn (Attacking)
positions.keyConcept: Rook behind passer = ideal, push pawn, king approaches
positions.studyMethod: Practice: rook behind, king support, promote

positions.name: Rook Cutting Off King
positions.keyConcept: Cut king off on rank/file, limit mobility
positions.studyMethod: Practice cutoff distances (2 ranks = draw usually)

positions.name: Checking Distance (Draw)
positions.keyConcept: Rook gives checks from far away, king cannot escape

positions.name: Activity > Material (Rook on 7th)
positions.keyConcept: Active rook on 7th rank compensates for pawn

categories.name: Minor Piece Endgames
categories.description: Bishop vs Knight, Same-color bishops, Opposite-color bishops

positions.name: Bishop vs Knight (General)
positions.keyConcept: Bishop better in open positions, Knight better in closed/blocked
positions.studyMethod: Identify pawn structure, place pieces accordingly

positions.name: Same-Color Bishops (Attacking)
positions.result: win if pawns on opposite color to bishop
positions.keyConcept: Pawns on opposite color = bishop attacks weaknesses
positions.studyMethod: Practice fixing pawns on opposite color

positions.name: Opposite-Color Bishops (Drawing Tendency)
positions.result: often draw even with extra pawn
positions.keyConcept: Cannot control same squares, defender holds

positions.name: Two Bishops vs Bishop+Knight
positions.keyConcept: Two bishops control both colors, dominate

positions.name: Knight on Outpost vs Bad Bishop
positions.keyConcept: Knight on protected outpost dominates bad bishop
positions.studyMethod: Create outposts, fix pawns on bishop's color

categories.name: Queen Endgames
categories.description: Perpetual check danger, king activity critical

positions.name: Queen vs Pawn on 7th Rank
positions.keyConcept: King approaches, queen pins, avoid stalemate

positions.name: Perpetual Check Patterns
positions.keyConcept: Check from distance, king cannot hide

positions.name: King Activity in Queen Endings
positions.keyConcept: Centralize king, create mating threats, support pawns
positions.studyMethod: Practice king walks in queen endings

positions.name: Fortress Patterns
positions.keyConcept: Blockaded pawns, king cannot penetrate
positions.studyMethod: Recognize fortress structures, don't break them

positions.name: Mutual Zugzwang
positions.keyConcept: Position where any move worsens position

positions.name: Shouldering (King pushes enemy king)
positions.keyConcept: Use king to restrict enemy king from key squares
